svg.title: KernelDarwin numerical gates and separate timing confirmation
svg.desc: All 280 retained individual paired ratios and seven fixed-candidate median ratio intervals share one linear speedup axis. Softmax includes a separate selected-candidate confirmation; sum retains its no-improvement result. No new timings, CUDA execution or GPU claim.

g.text: Sum: numerical checks pass, no improvement.
Large marks: ratio of medians + paired 95% bootstrap.
Small dots: all 40 paired time ratios per row.
Dashed line: lower bound must exceed 1.03.
CPU implementation comparison; no GPU result or new run.
Fixed-candidate intervals are not a multiple-search guarantee.
